semiconductor_relevance: High — KNE Corporation provides critical equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in back-end processes.
summary: KNE Corporation specializes in manufacturing high-speed, high-precision handlers and coating equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on factory automation and back-end processes. Their offerings include vacuum processing equipment and contract development services, supporting the entire lifecycle from design to prototyping.
capabilities: High-speed, high-precision handlers for back-end semiconductor processes
High-speed coating equipment for industrial liquids
Contract development services for innovative equipment

regional_presence.Japan: Headquartered in Fukuoka, Kyushu, KNE Corporation serves customers worldwide from this location.
